# Casia Lab

> Casia builds tools for the people doing the business. One workspace for your team and the agents that support them: switch on the tools you need for stock, money, buying, people and marketing, and hire an AI agent when the routine work piles up. A person approves every change. Do it easy.

Casia Lab is part of Casia Growth Lab LLC. It builds software for growing, owner-led businesses.

Most business software is built for the job function, so the experience breaks for the people who do the work. Casia's tools are built for those people: the storekeeper taking a delivery, the bookkeeper matching a bank line, the owner who does a bit of everything.

How it works:

- You create a workspace yourself and switch on one tool at a time. Every tool starts with a free trial, and no card is needed.
- Your whole team uses one sign-in and is included in every tool. There are no per-user fees. When someone leaves, their access ends everywhere.
- The tools pass work along. For example, goods received in Inventory reach Finance on their own, at cost, ready for someone to approve. Nothing posts to the books without a person.
- Agents are AI workers you hire by the month for one job inside a tool. They propose; a person approves, changes or rejects each proposal, and everything an agent does is logged.
- Most tools also have AI help built in, paid with prepaid credits.
- Prices are in US dollars, before any tax.

## Tools

- [Inventory](https://www.ceazr.com): stock across every store and warehouse, what's running low or idle, batches and expiry dates, and who changed what.
- [Finance](https://www.yakobooks.com): add a bank statement and see what you earned, what you owe and what tax is due. Every figure traces to its source.
- [Procurement](https://procurement.casialab.com): requests, supplier quotes, approvals and purchase orders, with supplier bills matched to the order and to what arrived.
- [People ops](https://road10.casialab.com): every role written down, with hiring, onboarding, appraisals, leave and staff records run from it. $5 a month for the first 6 people, then $1 a person.
- [Marketing](https://www.admeistr.com): content calendars, creative handoff, and Meta, Google and TikTok results tracked against the plan. In beta, free while in beta.

## Agents

- [Bookkeeper](https://www.yakobooks.com/bookkeeper): in Finance. Codes each bank line to the right account and flags lines that need splitting or aren't business costs. Early access.
- [Stock controller](https://www.ceazr.com/stock-controller): in Inventory. Brings in sheets and files, checks deliveries against the order, proposes reorders, works through expiry dates and plans stock counts.
- [Procurement officer](https://procurement.casialab.com/pricing#procurement-officer): in Procurement. Turns emailed requests into draft requisitions, drafts orders, chases late confirmations and deliveries, and flags contract renewals.

## Pricing

- [Pricing calculator](https://casialab.com/#pricing): pick your tools and see a monthly or yearly estimate. Your workspace is free to create.
- Each tool's price is also on its own site: [Inventory](https://www.ceazr.com/pricing), [Finance](https://www.yakobooks.com/pricing), [Procurement](https://procurement.casialab.com/pricing).
